title: When BIG-IP APM is provisioned and a per-request policy that includes the Client Information agent and Endpoint…
description: A critical vulnerability exists in BIG-IP APM when provisioned with a per-request policy including the Client Information and Endpoint Security agents. Undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate, disrupting traffic and potentially allowing remote code execution (RCE). This issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. Versions that have reached End of Technical Support are not evaluated.
